close_reason: Added [features] default=[]/std=[...] to pkix-ct/Cargo.toml, #![cfg_attr(not(feature='std'), no_std)] to lib.rs, gated impl std::error::Error behind #[cfg(feature='std')]. Builds both with and without --all-features. Now consistent with pkix-ac.
description:
Peer stub crates pkix-ac, pkix-composite both have:
  #![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]
  [features]
  default = []
  std     = [...]
  impl std::error::Error for Error  -> behind #[cfg(feature = "std")]

pkix-ct/src/lib.rs is std-only with no `std` feature gate at all (line 79 has `impl std::error::Error for Error` unconditionally), and Cargo.toml has no [features] section. The crate-level `# Limitations` says only 'Not yet implemented'.

This is inconsistent: pkix-ct is the only non-no_std stub. If it stays std-only, that's a deliberate choice and should be documented. If the intent is for pkix-ct to eventually be no_std-capable (parsing SCT extensions doesn't require networking), the std feature should be added now to lock in the surface.

Severity: P3 / opinion. Not a defect of the current implementation; a consistency/forward-compat concern.

Fix: add to pkix-ct/Cargo.toml:
  [features]
  default = []
  std     = ["der/std", "x509-cert/std"]

And to lib.rs:
  #![cfg_attr(not(feature = "std"), no_std)]
  ...
  #[cfg(feature = "std")]
  impl std::error::Error for Error {}

Pass-1 attribution: not addressed — the stub-crate version bump (PKIX-gdvf) only changed Cargo.toml versions, not feature shape.
title: P3: pkix-ct uses std::error::Error unconditionally without an std feature gate (inconsistent with peer stubs)
